Paper.lem_count_interleave : ∀ (k E : ℕ), Paper.stateCount E ^ k ≤ Paper.stateCount (k ^ 2 * E)
'Paper.lem_count_interleave' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Paper.lem_count : ∃ κ,
  0 < κ ∧
    (∀ (E : ℕ), Real.log ↑(Paper.stateCount E) ≤ κ * √↑E) ∧
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ (E : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (κ - ε) * √↑E ≤ Real.log ↑(Paper.stateCount E)
'Paper.lem_count' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Paper.eq_orth : ∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] (y : A) (R i j : ℕ),
  y ^ R ∣ (1 - y) * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R, y ^ r * (Nc.Cross.mB y r i * Nc.Cross.mB y r j) - if i = j then y ^ i else 0
'Paper.eq_orth' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Paper.prop_identity_schur : ∀ {p : Type u_1} {q : Type u_2} {ρ : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype p] [inst_1 : DecidableEq p]
  [inst_2 : Fintype q] [inst_3 : DecidableEq q] [inst_4 : Fintype ρ] [inst_5 : DecidableEq ρ] {R : Type u_4}
  [inst_6 : CommRing R] (l : ρ → R) (X : Matrix p p R) (A : Matrix p ρ R) (A' : Matrix ρ p R) (Y : Matrix q q R)
  (B : Matrix ρ q R) (B' : Matrix q ρ R),
  (Matrix.fromBlocks X (A * Matrix.diagonal l * B) (B' * Matrix.diagonal l * A') Y).det =
    (Matrix.fromBlocks (Matrix.fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 B')
        (-Matrix.fromBlocks 0 (Matrix.diagonal l * B) (Matrix.diagonal l * A') 0) 1).det
'Paper.prop_identity_schur' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Paper.prop_identity_term_zero : ∀ {p : Type u_1} {q : Type u_2} {ρ : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype p]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq p] [inst_2 : Fintype q] [inst_3 : DecidableEq q] [inst_4 : Fintype ρ] [inst_5 : DecidableEq ρ]
  {R : Type u_4} [inst_6 : CommRing R] (T : Finset (ρ ⊕ ρ)),
  T.toLeft.card ≠ T.toRight.card →
    ∀ (X : Matrix p p R) (A : Matrix p ρ R) (A' : Matrix ρ p R) (Y : Matrix q q R) (B : Matrix ρ q R)
      (B' : Matrix q ρ R), (Nc.Cross.termMat T X A A' Y B B').det = 0
'Paper.prop_identity_term_zero' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Paper.prop_identity_term_product : ∀ {p : Type u_1} {q : Type u_2} {ρ : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype p]
  [inst_1 : DecidableEq p] [inst_2 : Fintype q] [inst_3 : DecidableEq q] [inst_4 : Fintype ρ] [inst_5 : DecidableEq ρ]
  {R : Type u_4} [inst_6 : CommRing R] (T : Finset (ρ ⊕ ρ)),
  ∃ α β,
    ∀ (X : Matrix p p R) (A : Matrix p ρ R) (A' : Matrix ρ p R) (Y : Matrix q q R) (B : Matrix ρ q R)
      (B' : Matrix q ρ R), (Nc.Cross.termMat T X A A' Y B B').det = α X A A' * β Y B B'
'Paper.prop_identity_term_product' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
@Paper.prop_identity_reflection_coeff : ∀ {μ ν : ℕ} (sa : Nc.Cross.Wd μ) (sb : Nc.Cross.Wd ν) (sc : Nc.Cross.Wd μ)
  (sd : Nc.Cross.Wd ν) {e₁ e₂ : ℕ},
  Nc.Cross.enW sa = e₁ →
    Nc.Cross.enW sb = e₂ →
      Nc.Cross.enW sc = e₁ →
        Nc.Cross.enW sd = e₂ →
          (Nc.Cross.psi Polynomial.X sa sb sc sd).natDegree ≤ 2 * (e₁ + e₂) ∧
            ∀ (N M : ℕ),
              N + M = 2 * (e₁ + e₂) →
                (Nc.Cross.psi Polynomial.X sa sb sc sd).coeff N = (Nc.Cross.psi Polynomial.X sa sd sc sb).coeff M
'Paper.prop_identity_reflection_coeff' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
Paper.prop_identity : ∀ (μ ν e₁ e₂ : ℕ),
  ∃ Ψ,
    (∀ (a : ↥(Nc.Cross.states μ e₁)) (b : ↥(Nc.Cross.states ν e₂)) (c : ↥(Nc.Cross.states μ e₁))
        (d : ↥(Nc.Cross.states ν e₂)), ∑ N, Ψ N a b c d = (if a = c then 1 else 0) * if b = d then 1 else 0) ∧
      (∀ (N : Fin (2 * (e₁ + e₂) + 1)),
          ∃ g h,
            ∀ (a : ↥(Nc.Cross.states μ e₁)) (b : ↥(Nc.Cross.states ν e₂)) (c : ↥(Nc.Cross.states μ e₁))
              (d : ↥(Nc.Cross.states ν e₂)), Ψ N a b c d = ∑ k, g k (a, d) * h k (b, c)) ∧
        ∀ (N : Fin (2 * (e₁ + e₂) + 1)) (N' : ℕ),
          N' = 2 * (e₁ + e₂) - ↑N →
            ∃ g h,
              ∀ (a : ↥(Nc.Cross.states μ e₁)) (b : ↥(Nc.Cross.states ν e₂)) (c : ↥(Nc.Cross.states μ e₁))
                (d : ↥(Nc.Cross.states ν e₂)), Ψ N a b c d = ∑ k, g k (a, b) * h k (c, d)
'Paper.prop_identity' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
